pairs.subject: client-fetch-cache
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/messages/useMessagesData.ts:49 Every run of the hand-rolled fetch effect (retry, or the Activity boundary re-running effects when a kept view is shown again) flips loading back to true, and the view then swaps the rows it already holds for ghosts, so a refresh blocks the paint instead of revalidating behind cached data.

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/messages/index.tsx:142 The ghost branch is chosen on `loading` alone, not on 'loading and nothing held'. That breaks MessageRowGhosts' own doc ('Shown only while nothing is held; a refetch keeps the last rows on screen') and the stale-window rule to serve the cache and refresh behind it.

src/components/dashboard/views/messages/useMessagesData.ts:39 Fetched threads live in component state, with no module-scoped last-result map. Once ViewOutlet's KEEP_ALIVE=4 drops the view, a remount starts cold (loading=true, empty list).

src/components/dashboard/views/messages/useMessagesData.ts:51 The fetcher is called directly from a per-view effect with no keyed join registry. A retry while a flight is still out launches a second identical request, and the `cancelled` flag only drops the first one's result (latest-wins, not dedup).
src/components/dashboard/views/messages/useMessagesData.ts:72 A pure scope projection memoized by input reference identity. The derivation function stays the single door.
src/components/dashboard/views/messages/index.tsx:89 The detail modal takes the full thread straight from the list by id. No separate detail read exists for a summary to warm.
src/components/dashboard/views/messages/useMessagesData.ts:44 There is no keyed cache here at all, let alone one keyed on resemblance.

pairs.subject: client-fetch-cache
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/incidents/incidents-page/useAuditIncidents.ts:21 The incidents read goes through SWR under one registered key. It gets a fetch-layer join, a module-scoped cache that survives remount, held data shown during revalidation, and a write surface (fixCause's mutate over DEMO_THREAD_KEYS) that updates the entry when the demo thread settles.

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/incidents/incidents-page/useAuditIncidents.ts:21 SWR's keyed dedup at the fetch layer (dedupingInterval 60s in the shared hook) means concurrent readers join one flight.

src/lib/demoThreads.ts:13 One key registry that both the reader and the fix-writer import, for a read that takes no arguments. The tenant axis is handled by nulling the key outside demo, so a real tenant's session never reads the fixture entry.

src/components/dashboard/views/incidents/index.tsx:64 Placeholders show only when nothing is held, so a revalidation keeps the last data painted. Focus and reconnect refetch are off. The stale ceiling is not named, but the source is a static fixture.

src/components/dashboard/views/incidents/index.tsx:63 The SWR global cache outlives the view, so a remount paints warm with no T2 entrance. Updates are pushed into the cache by fixCause (mutate per thread key).
src/components/dashboard/views/incidents/index.tsx:54 A pure filter derivation memoized on the input reference plus the filter values. The applyIncidentFilters function stays the door to recompute.
src/components/dashboard/views/incidents/index.tsx:44 The detail modal receives the full list row. There is no detail read for a summary to warm.
src/components/dashboard/views/incidents/incidents-page/useAuditIncidents.ts:9 The entry is keyed by an identity string, not by resemblance.

pairs.registryProposal: swr-design's 'name both thresholds' rule has no clause for a static fixture source, where the honest stale ceiling is 'forever' and the only live trigger is an explicit write. A short carve-out would stop seats from splitting on demo-only reads.
